senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; לחח to be sticky, sappy, fresh) moist, green, fresh; liquid; opp. יבש.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 2:3">Dem. II, 3</cite> <he>לח ויבש</he> either fresh or dried fruits.

Ib. 5 ובלח דינר in selling fresh fruits (or liquids), a denar’s worth is wholesale; Y. ib. II, end, 23ᵃ נתנו דמים ללח וכ׳ for fresh fruit they adopt the standard of value, for dried that of quantity (cmp. לוּמָּא); Tosef. ib. III, 12 ובלח הין and for liquids the standard is a Hin.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79:7">Gen. R. s. 79</cite>, beg. (play on <he>כלח</he>, <cite ref="Job 5:26">Job V, 26</cite>) <he>תבא לח וכ׳</he> thou shalt die in the possession of vigor (cmp.
<cite ref="Shabbat 49a:4">Sabb. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>כסות ל׳</he> a moist garment; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לַחִים</he>, <he>לַחִין</he>; <he>לַחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 49a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ל׳ מחמת עצמן וכ׳</he> naturally moist, <he>ל׳ מחמת דבר אחר</he> moist through some incident.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:23">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ל׳ היו שמים וכ׳</he> the heavens were liquid …, and on the second day they congealed (v. <cite ref="C00877"><he>גָּלַד</he></cite>); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4:7">Gen. R. s. 4</cite>, beg. <he>ל׳ היו מעשיהם</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="L00336"><he>לֵחָה</he></cite>.
